use_when.text: Use Primary for the one main action on a screen, such as Report lost item.
Use Outline for a secondary action next to a Primary, such as Cancel or Back.
Use Ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars.
Turn on Icon Left when an icon makes the action clearer, such as plus for Add item.
Turn on Icon Right for actions that move the user forward, such as Next.

dont_use_when.text: Do not put two Primary buttons in the same group.
Do not use Ghost for the main action on a screen.
Do not use a button to go to another page. Use a link.
Do not make it narrower than 172 or truncate the Label.
Do not hide the Label to make an icon-only button.

best_practice.text: Write the Label as a short verb and noun, such as Submit claim. Change the height with the density mode on the frame, not by hand.
Set the width to Fill for full-width buttons on mobile. When a button is disabled, say why next to it.

variant_intent.intent: Use Primary for the one main action on a screen, such as Report lost item.
Use Outline for a secondary action next to a Primary, such as Cancel or Back.
Use Ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars.
Use Hover when the pointer is over it.
Use Disabled when the action is not available yet.

placement.text: Dialog Box actions row: Outline Cancel first, then Primary confirm.
Top Nav actions, right side: Ghost "Sign in", then Primary "Report an item".

a11y.text: Renders a native <button> with type="button" by default.
State Disabled sets the native disabled attribute.
The Icon Left and Icon Right wrappers are aria-hidden="true"; the Label is the accessible name.
Build it as a native button element. If that is not possible, use role="button" and handle Enter and Space.
Keep a visible focus indicator on keyboard focus (:focus-visible). Do not remove the browser outline without replacing it.
Use aria-disabled="true" when a disabled button must stay focusable, so screen readers still announce it.
On Mobile density the button is 48 px tall, which meets the 48 px touch target. Web and Back Office are shorter because they are used with a pointer.
Label contrast stays above 4.5:1 in every enabled state. Mark icons aria-hidden="true" when the Label is showing.

gaps.detail: Button imports no other component; Icon Left swap and Icon Right swap take any ReactNode (Button.tsx:12, 15) and no story fills them, so no paired component is shown.
